item.title: Apple's M5 MacBook Pro is here with a brighter display and 24-hour battery life
item.description: Apple has refreshed the 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro with M5, M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, a brighter mini-LED screen and up to 24 hours of battery life.

item.title: Apple recalls Beats Pill speakers over overheating batteries
item.description: Apple is recalling about 200,000 Beats Pill speakers after reports that the battery can overheat while charging.

item.title: Amazon Web Services is down, taking a big chunk of the internet with it
item.description: An AWS outage in the US-EAST-1 region is breaking apps and websites, from Slack and Venmo to Ring doorbells and Fortnite.

item.title: Valve's Steam Frame headset gets a November release date
item.description: Valve's standalone VR headset will ship on November 12th, starting at $599 for the 256GB model.
